'''Blessing''' was one of the two daughters of [[Hunter (clone)|Hunter]] and [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], two [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] produced on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. She, along with her sister, [[Grace (Human)|Grace]], and nearly all of the other clones save for [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], had begun suffering an illness once they left the moon for [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]. Blessing succumbed to the sickness on Fhost.
